name: Anime! Oi History!
source:
You are the greatest girl named Kolazya! Brave, strong, kind, clever! But then on the way home, you meet a stranger who says that her friend kidnapped! So begins the story Nikolaz! 

You'll meet a lot of new friends, such as Morry, cat, oi, and many others! 

[From [url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/581280/]Steam[/url]]

你是最伟大的女孩，名叫Korazya！勇敢、坚强、善良、聪明！但在回家的路上，你遇到了一个陌生人，他说她的朋友被绑架了！故事就这样开始了，尼古拉斯！

你会遇到很多新朋友，比如Morry、cat、oi等等！
